description: Language and framework style presets. Each preset is a named, selectable bundle of flagIds from programming-style-types.json plus a summary rule and usage guidance. Presets are defaults the user can pick from and then override per flag.

fields.name: Human-readable preset name.
fields.language: Primary language or format the preset targets.
fields.flagIds: Ordered list of style flagIds this preset enables. All ids must exist in programming-style-types.json.
fields.llmRule: Summary instruction the LLM must follow when this preset is active.
fields.whenToUse: Projects or situations this preset is intended for.

presets.name: Unity C#
presets.description: Microsoft/Unity C# conventions: PascalCase types and members, Allman braces, 4-space indent, XML docs, nullable reference types, and Unity inspector-field conventions.
presets.llmRule: Write Unity C# in Microsoft/Unity style: PascalCase types and members, camelCase locals, Allman braces, 4-space indent, XML docs on public API, nullable reference types, and [SerializeField] private inspector fields.
presets.whenToUse: Unity gameplay, editor, and tooling scripts written in C#.

presets.name: C++
presets.description: Google-influenced C++ conventions: PascalCase types and functions, snake_case variables, 2-space indent, 80-column lines, attached braces, trailing-underscore members, and const-correct modern C++.
presets.llmRule: Write modern, const-correct C++ in Google style: PascalCase types/functions, snake_case variables, trailing-underscore members, attached braces, 2-space indent, 80-column lines, #pragma once, and smart pointers over raw owning pointers.
presets.whenToUse: C++ codebases, including Unity native plugins, following Google or similar style guides.

presets.name: Python
presets.description: PEP 8 / Black-aligned Python: snake_case functions and variables, PascalCase classes, 4-space indent, 80-column lines, grouped imports, type hints, and PEP 257 docstrings.
presets.llmRule: Write PEP 8 compliant, Black-compatible Python: snake_case functions and variables, PascalCase classes, 4-space indent, 80-column lines, grouped imports, type hints, f-strings, and PEP 257 docstrings.
presets.whenToUse: Python scripts, tooling, and pipelines, including Unity build and asset automation.

presets.name: JavaScript
presets.description: Modern ES module JavaScript: camelCase functions and variables, attached braces, 2-space indent, 100-column lines, const over let, strict equality, arrow callbacks, and single quotes.
presets.llmRule: Write modern ES module JavaScript: camelCase functions and variables, 2-space indent, 100-column lines, const over let, strict equality, arrow callbacks, async/await, single quotes, and semicolons.
presets.whenToUse: Node scripts, Unity WebGL/web tooling, and general JavaScript projects.

presets.name: TypeScript
presets.description: Strict TypeScript: everything in the JavaScript preset plus explicit return types, strict null checks, no any, type aliases over interfaces, and literal unions over enums.
presets.llmRule: Write strict TypeScript: camelCase functions and variables, 2-space indent, 100-column lines, const over let, explicit return types, strict null checks, no any, type aliases over interfaces, and literal unions over enums.

presets.name: UXML
presets.description: Unity UI Toolkit UXML markup: 2-space indent, one attribute per line, BEM-style USS classes, and classes instead of inline styles.
presets.llmRule: Write UXML with 2-space indent, one attribute per line for multi-attribute elements, BEM-style USS class names, and no inline styles.

presets.name: USS
presets.description: Unity UI Toolkit USS stylesheets: consistent property order, custom-property variables, low specificity, no !important, and consistent units.
presets.llmRule: Write USS with BEM-style class names, consistent box-model property order, custom-property variables for colours and spacing, low selector specificity, no !important, and consistent units.

presets.name: Shader (ShaderLab/HLSL)
presets.description: Unity ShaderLab/HLSL conventions: 4-space indent, next-line braces, underscore-prefixed uniforms, PascalCase properties, section banners, half precision, and branch avoidance.
presets.llmRule: Write ShaderLab/HLSL with 4-space indent, next-line braces, underscore-prefixed uniforms, PascalCase properties, section comment banners, half precision where safe, and no dynamic branching in fragment shaders.
presets.whenToUse: Unity ShaderLab, HLSL, and shader graph code export.
